prototype: Aluminum cantilever teaching rig with movable load hanger and dial gauge
checklist_source: Rig builders' published procedure, section 5, figure 7 and table 2, https://peer.asee.org/effective-use-of-an-undergraduate-research-fellowship-for-design-and-manufacture-of-tools-to-assist-in-teaching-strength-of-materials.pdf
candidate_pass_attribution: First response, repair and registry-guided refinement are not distinguished in the saved candidate records.

candidates.title: What if the students place the hanger at the clamp instead of at the free end?

task: Students set up a hanger and dial gauge on this aluminum beam. Which changes to how they use the apparatus could affect the measured displacement? Compare with the single weight at the free end.
reviewer: Codex, retrospective comparison of the frozen builders' checklist with the original completed batch

conditions.description: Hang the nominal test weight at B (half span) and read displacement at C (the free end).
conditions.review_reason: The intake supplied the free-end load and described the clamped support. The proposal introduced a different hanger location. It chose the clamp rather than the prescribed half span and omitted the dial reading at the free end. No comparison ran.
conditions.quote: change the load application point from the free end to the clamp
conditions.candidate_reason: What is the expected change in the maximum deflection or surface bending stress if the hanger is placed at the clamp instead of the free end? Provide a calculation based on the provided facts and the beam's properties.

conditions.description: Use the same weight at C, move the gauge to B and compare that reading with the first. Comparing two tip readings does not establish reciprocity.
conditions.review_reason: The free-end weight was already the supplied reference. The batch never proposed keeping that weight at the tip, moving the gauge to half span, or comparing the two reciprocal readings.

conditions.description: Keep the dial probe perpendicular to the beam and on its longitudinal centerline at each gauge position.
conditions.review_reason: Neither the candidate nor its clarification addressed the dial probe's direction or contact on the beam centerline.

conditions.description: Set the gauge bracket to give approximately 1 mm of initial probe compression.
conditions.review_reason: Neither the candidate nor its clarification addressed the initial compression of the dial probe.

interventions: The evaluator transcribed the rig builders' published procedure into a four-condition checklist before intake. No live operator of this rig took part.

The operator translated the published dimensions and load into SI units for the structural beam reference. The equivalent square section preserves the reported second moment of area. The operator selected a nominal aluminum modulus of 70 GPa consistent with the authors' theoretical displacement.
The operator entered the task and requested displacement measurements. The source gives no numerical acceptance limit for this teaching exercise.

After the first model response was truncated, the operator retried the same task on the same reference and project revision. The original failed attempt is retained in initial-batch.json and initial-results.json. No pilot-specific code was needed to submit the reference or task through the workbench.
